aboutGame.title: What is Feed A Mosquito?
paragraphs: Feed A Mosquito is a Roblox simulation-tycoon game from Be Diao VIII. You fight mosquitoes in the field for larvae, hatch eggs on your base plot, and feed each mosquito with your own health, which doubles as blood. A fully fed mosquito pays cash every second, while the same health pool keeps you alive in field fights.

Cash buys stronger weapons and health-station upgrades, and every new weapon tier opens tougher mosquitoes and better larvae. Feeding one mosquito at a time makes health regeneration the main limit on income, so the core loop is simple: bank cash at the green circle, upgrade the current bottleneck, and feed every new hatch toward 100%.

modules.name: Feed A Mosquito Beginner Guide
modules.description: Follow the first-session route from an empty base to a fully fed mosquito, a banked cash pickup, and the first weapon upgrade.

highlights.detail: Sit at the base seat to refill health, the same resource used as blood.
Attack a first-field mosquito with the default hand until its health bar empties.
Pick up a fallen larva; every drop in the first field is common.
Place the egg on the base plot and wait about seven seconds for it to open.
Feed the new mosquito with your blood to raise its payout percentage.
Walk over the green circle to bank the cash your mosquitoes produced.
Feed to 100% to unlock the mosquito's maximum cash per second.
Buy the 5,000-cash shoe to turn first-field kills into a repeatable route.

modules.name: Feed A Mosquito Fast Money Guide
modules.description: Use a repeatable cash routine: bank earnings, finish every feed, buy the next blocker upgrade, and reinvest into stronger weapons.

highlights.detail: Bank at the green circle before shopping; mosquitoes do not deposit cash for you.
Feed every new hatch to 100% before starting another mosquito.
Buy the 5,000 shoe, then the 35,000 broom when damage blocks progress.
Switch to the 15,000 health-station step when feeding drains faster than you recover.
At a boss gate, buy the required weapon and the best regeneration tier together.
At the 300,000-per-second plateau, move to the electric swatter and reserve the spray for bosses.

faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Feed A Mosquito.

items.question: What is Feed A Mosquito?
items.answer: Feed A Mosquito is a Roblox simulation-tycoon game from Be Diao VIII. You fight mosquitoes for larvae, hatch eggs at your base, feed the mosquitoes with your own health, and collect the cash they generate every second.

items.question: How do you make money fast in Feed A Mosquito?
items.answer: In Feed A Mosquito, bank cash at the green circle, feed every new mosquito to 100%, and spend the next batch of cash on the upgrade that is blocking your highest-paying mosquito. Weapons open stronger targets, while health-station tiers let you finish larger feeds.

items.question: How do eggs and mosquito growth work in Feed A Mosquito?
items.answer: Feed A Mosquito eggs come from larvae dropped by field mosquitoes. Place a larva on your base plot, wait about seven seconds for a common egg to open, then feed the new mosquito toward 100%. Feeding raises its payout and makes the model visibly larger.

items.question: What should I buy first in Feed A Mosquito?
items.answer: Start with the 5,000-cash shoe in Feed A Mosquito, then buy the 35,000-cash broom when a 2,000-HP field mosquito blocks progress. Move to the 15,000-cash health-station step when feeding drains your health faster than you can recover.

items.question: Does Feed A Mosquito have codes?
items.answer: Feed A Mosquito has no active public codes right now. New codes appear around content updates, so check the official Roblox game page and the in-game menu after each patch.

items.question: How do you beat bosses in Feed A Mosquito?
items.answer: Boss fights in Feed A Mosquito combine weapon damage with enough health to survive the feed and fight loop. Use the broom for the 2,000-HP field mosquito, the frying pan plus a bench for the roughly 500-health housewife, and the 1,000-Robux mosquito spray for Yeti and Fman.
